interpretation.theoretical_tier: Aspirational targets from model_performance_reference.json. NOT measured results.
interpretation.functional_tier: Current floor from release_model_spec.json. Represents what actually works today.
interpretation.gap_analysis: The 5x gap claim may compare to theoretical targets. Our Qwen3-8B at 27.4 tok/s is actually ABOVE the N300 functional floor (4.1 tok/s) and near the N300 complete tier (20.5 tok/s). For Qwen3-1.7B, the theoretical P150 target of 175 tok/s likely requires DRAM prefetcher and model-specific kernel tuning that TT hasn't shipped yet.
